import re
thread_ids=[47829, 9295, 47823, 47821, 47825, 47831]
results=[]
for tid in thread_ids:
    th=apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=tid, access_token=gmail_token)
    created=th.get('created_at')
    subj=th.get('emails',[{}])[0].get('subject') if th.get('emails') else None
    sender=th.get('emails',[{}])[0].get('sender',{}).get('email') if th.get('emails') else None
    body=th.get('emails',[{}])[0].get('body','') if th.get('emails') else ''
    # parse paid amount anchored
    m=re.search(r'You have paid\s*=>\s*\$\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)', body)
    amt=float(m.group(1)) if m else None
    m2=re.search(r'Card ending in\s*=>\s*\s*([0-9]+)', body)
    card_end=m2.group(1) if m2 else None
    # crude hotel detection: look for 'hotel' or 'room' in body/subject
    text=(subj or '')+'\n'+body[:2000]
    is_hotel=bool(re.search(r'\bhotel\b|\broom\b|\breservation\b|\bcheck-in\b', text, flags=re.I))
    results.append({'tid':tid,'created_at':created,'subject':subj,'sender':sender,'amt':amt,'card_end':card_end,'is_hotel':is_hotel,'body_snip':body[:150]})
print('thread analyses:')
for r in results:
    print(r)
# filter hotel and mastercard ending 3706
mc_last4='3706'
hotel_mc=[r for r in results if r['is_hotel'] and r['amt'] is not None and r['card_end']==mc_last4]
print('hotel_mc count', len(hotel_mc))
print('hotel_mc items', hotel_mc)
if hotel_mc:
    total=sum(r['amt'] for r in hotel_mc)
    print('total', total)

import re
hotel_tids=[47823,47821,47825]
mc_last4='3706'
# ensure tokens
assert gmail_token and fs_token

def parse_bill(tid):
    th=apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=tid, access_token=gmail_token)
    em=th['emails'][0]
    att=em.get('attachments',[])[0]
    file_name=att['file_name']
    abs_path='/home/lindsey/downloads/'+file_name
    # file exists now maybe; ensure
    if not apis.file_system.file_exists(file_path=abs_path, access_token=fs_token)['exists']:
        apis.gmail.download_attachment(attachment_id=att['id'], file_system_access_token=fs_token, access_token=gmail_token, download_to_file_path=abs_path)
    f=apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=abs_path, access_token=fs_token)
    content=f['content']
    # anchored fields
    payer=re.search(r'Payer Name\s*=>\s*(.*)', content)
    total_m=re.search(r'Total\s*=>\s*\$\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)', content)
    paid_card=re.search(r'Paid by Card\s*=>\s*\*+([0-9]+)', content)
    checkin=re.search(r'Check-in date\s*=>\s*(.*)', content)
    checkout=re.search(r'Check-out date\s*=>\s*(.*)', content)
    hotel_name=None
    # header: first line '# Bill for ...'
    m_header=re.search(r'^#\s*Bill for\s*(.*)$', content, flags=re.M)
    if m_header: hotel_name=m_header.group(1).strip()
    total=float(total_m.group(1)) if total_m else None
    paid_card_end=paid_card.group(1) if paid_card else None
    payer_name=payer.group(1).strip() if payer else None
    return {
        'tid':tid,
        'file':abs_path,
        'hotel_name':hotel_name,
        'payer':payer_name,
        'checkin':checkin.group(1).strip() if checkin else None,
        'checkout':checkout.group(1).strip() if checkout else None,
        'total':total,
        'paid_card_end':paid_card_end,
        'content_head':content[:120]
    }

parsed=[parse_bill(tid) for tid in hotel_tids]
for p in parsed:
    print(p)
# filter for master card
mc=[p for p in parsed if p['paid_card_end']==mc_last4 and p['total'] is not None]
print('mc count',len(mc))
print('mc totals', [p['total'] for p in mc])
mc_sum=sum(p['total'] for p in mc)
print('mc_sum', mc_sum)
